runbook: Check CPU/memory trend for the last hour in CloudWatch
Confirm the Auto Scaling group reached desired capacity
If a single instance is unhealthy, replace it; if fleet-wide, raise max capacity
Check load balancer target health and latency metrics
Review VPC Flow Logs and Route 53 health checks
Verify VPN/Direct Connect tunnel status
Check connection count against max_connections
Review replica lag and slow-query log
Fail over to the standby if the primary is unhealthy
Identify the volume or bucket and current utilization
Expand the EBS volume or clean up old snapshots/logs
Check IOPS/throughput limits for the volume type
Open the finding in GuardDuty/Security Hub and preserve evidence
Identify the principal and source IP; disable keys if compromise is likely
Follow the incident response playbook (NIST SP 800-61r3)
Check the most recent deployment and roll back if errors started after it
Review application logs for the top exception
Confirm downstream dependencies are healthy
Open Cost Explorer filtered to the service and day
Identify untagged or newly launched resources
Confirm with the owning team before stopping resources
